text:
Counting about 9 raspberries (roughly 4 g each, about 36 g) and 5 blackberries (roughly 6 g each, about 30 g), plus a few crumbs, gives about 70 g of food. At roughly 0.5 kcal/g for the berries, that is about 35 kcal, and the crumbs add about 5 kcal, for a total of about 40 kcal.
